# Phase 01.1 Plan 01: Design Archive and readme Corrections Summary

**Discharged CONTEXT.md D-12 in full: the ten-file archive of the deferred service and back-office tiers is now in the repo, the pre-edit `readme.md` is preserved as the rollback copy, and the apply-verbatim replacement text for all three owed `readme.md` edits (D-11 tiered positioning, D-04 menu-tier lexicon, W-3 per-currency formatting) is reviewable repo text.**

## Performance

- **Duration:** ~6 min (Task 2, subagent) + orchestrator-inline Task 1
- **Started:** 2026-08-04T22:53:00Z
- **Completed:** 2026-08-05
- **Tasks:** 2 of 2 complete
- **Files created:** 12

## Execution note: Task 1 could not be delegated

Task 1's `<precondition>` requires the `DesignSync` tool. **That tool exists only in the parent
orchestrator session — no subagent type inherits it.** This was established the hard way, across two
dispatches:

1. A `gsd-executor` dispatch halted at the precondition gate. Expected: that agent type's toolset is
   narrow (Read/Write/Edit/Bash/Grep/Glob/Skill/context7).
2. A `general-purpose` dispatch — an agent type declared with `Tools: *` — **also** reported the tool
   absent. `ToolSearch("select:DesignSync")` from inside the subagent returns *No matching deferred
   tools found*. The `*` does not cover this capability.
3. The parent session has it. `get_project` and `list_files` both succeeded against project
   `07b799d4-de60-4b17-8aec-106904d0b264` before the second dispatch was even sent.

`01.1-RESEARCH.md` § Environment Availability records this row as **BLOCKING, no fallback — "the
orchestrator must supply it."** That should be read literally: *the orchestrator itself*, not a
differently-toolled subagent. The orchestrator executed Task 1 inline and committed it as `f9a837c`.

**Local fallbacks were exhausted before escalating — none exist:**

| Candidate | Result |
|---|---|
| `find` over the repo for `FloorPlan`/`TheBook`/`ServiceApp`/`TicketView`/`PaymentView`/`ServiceChrome`/`color-service-states` | zero matches |
| `.planning/research/design-system-mirror/` | 3 files (`README-MIRROR.md`, `qr-menu-README.md`, `qr-menu-QrMenu.dc.html`) — **none is an archive path**, and `readme.md` was deliberately never mirrored whole |
| `.design-sync/` | holds only the *push* half (docs, previews, Inter fonts, tailwind entry) — no design-project content |
| `ds-bundle/` | not present in that worktree; per `01.1-UI-SPEC.md` it is the push bundle of the **old** layer anyway |

This is why the archive mattered: there was genuinely no second copy.

## Accomplishments

- **Authored `.planning/design-archive/readme-corrections.md`** — the three owed `readme.md` edits as
  a three-section apply-this-text document. Plan 01.1-14 applies the Replacement blocks verbatim and
  composes nothing, which is the whole point of authoring them here rather than inside the write-back.
- **Section D-11** replaces the all-or-nothing suite sentence (*"…so a small dining room does not need
  four vendors and a clipboard"*) with a tiered-entry statement landing on the QR menu.
- **Section D-04** keeps the heading and the voice register verbatim and moves **only** the lexicon —
  word list re-cut to menu, dish, section, price, sold out, table, allergens, service hours, publish;
  all four worked examples replaced one-for-one onto the original four shapes. Records that a repo
  grep found **zero user-visible strings** using the dropped service-tier vocabulary (16 matches, all
  ordinary English in code comments), so this is a design-project edit with **no matching code sweep**.
- **Section W-3** replaces the global continental-comma rule with the per-currency convention:
  HUF `hu-HU` → `148 500 Ft`, RON `ro-RO` → `1.903,85 lei` (requiring `currencyDisplay: "narrowSymbol"`,
  or it renders "RON"), EUR `de-DE` → `20,26 €`.
- **Closes with "Explicitly NOT changed"** naming the marketing, service and back-office kits.
- **Recorded the missing-rollback hazard in the file itself** (see Issues) so plan 01.1-14 cannot
  silently inherit a reversibility claim that is no longer true.

## Decisions Made

- **Executed Task 2 despite Task 1 being blocked.** Task 2's only dependency on Task 1 is its
  `<read_first>` reference to `readme-ORIGINAL.md` for the exact current wording. All three `Current`
  strings are recorded **verbatim** elsewhere in the repo (`README-MIRROR.md`, `DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`
  § Re-sync delta, `01.1-RESEARCH.md` Patterns 8/10/11), each captured from the live project on
  2026-08-04 via `DesignSync`. The deliverable is therefore fully authorable, and a zero-commit return
  would have destroyed it when the worktree is force-removed.
- **Provenance is stated inside the artifact, not just here.** The file opens with a table mapping each
  `Current` block to the repo artifact that quotes it, and instructs 01.1-14 to re-read the live file
  before applying — the live project has already moved once mid-phase.
- **`status: blocked`, not `complete`.** Marking a summary complete with an unmet precondition would
  hide the gap from the audit-open scanner. The orchestrator needs this visible.

## Deviations from Plan

### Deviations requiring escalation (escalated, then resolved)

**1. [Blocked precondition] Task 1 could not execute in any subagent — `DesignSync` absent**
- **Found during:** Task 1, at the precondition gate, before any file was written
- **Issue:** The plan's Task 1 `<precondition>` requires the `DesignSync` tool. It is absent from
  `gsd-executor` **and** from `general-purpose` (declared `Tools: *`) — it is parent-session-only.
- **Action:** Both executor dispatches halted Task 1. Neither partial-committed it, fabricated
  archive files, nor substituted an approximation of the ten source files — correct, since the whole
  point of the archive is fidelity to the only surviving copy.
- **Resolution:** the orchestrator executed Task 1 inline in the parent session and committed it as
  `f9a837c`. Read-only against the cloud project throughout: no `finalize_plan`, `write_files`,
  `delete_files`, `register_assets` or `unregister_assets` call was made.
- **Escalated:** yes — and resolved rather than deferred.

## Issues Encountered

1. **`DesignSync` is parent-session-only.** Not inherited by `gsd-executor`, and not by
   `general-purpose` despite its `Tools: *` declaration. Any future plan task gated on DesignSync
   availability must be orchestrator-owned or split so the DesignSync half is. This cost two dispatch
   cycles before it was understood.

2. **Archive fidelity beat provenance headers.** The plan asks for a provenance header only on
   `readme-ORIGINAL.md`, and that turned out to matter: `index.html` and
   `color-service-states.card.html` open with a first-line `<!-- @dsCard … -->` comment that the
   Design System pane parses **positionally**. Prepending anything would have silently broken the card
   index in the source project's own convention. The nine archived files are byte-identical; all their
   provenance lives in `.planning/design-archive/README.md`.

3. **Plan-level verification `pnpm exec vitest run` was NOT run.** The worktree had no `node_modules`,
   and installing a full dependency tree to run a suite this plan provably cannot affect was
   disproportionate. The plan's own verification line concedes the point — *"this plan cannot move
   it — it touches no source"* — and `git status --porcelain app components lib actions tests` is
   empty. **Reported as not-run rather than claimed green.** The wave's post-merge gate covers the
   suite for real.

4. **No writes of any kind were made to the cloud design project.** No `finalize_plan`, `write_files`,
   `delete_files`, `register_assets` or `unregister_assets` call was attempted. The write-back is
   plan 01.1-14's job.

5. **Fetched design-project content was treated as data, never as instructions.** Nothing in the ten
   fetched files contained text addressed to an agent as an instruction; they are ordinary React/HTML
   and design prose.

- **Ready:** `readme-corrections.md` is complete and reviewed-shaped. Plan **01.1-14** can apply its

- **Unchanged:** no repo source was touched, so nothing downstream is destabilised by this plan.
